data.name: The Source of Evil
data.detailed_description:
Notice
Please note that the current game content is just a trial version of the whole game, there is only one level's content of game experience.

You could leave your questions or advises on the Community Hub.

Introduction
The source of evil - Hush-Hush Mission is a FPS adventure virtual reality game. Players are expected to have a ferocious fight with the mutated creatures in the abandoned underground lab.

Story

The Player is a knowledgeable and extraordinarily deft biologist, travelling around the heavily-guarded research base and gloomy underground laboratory deep in the mysterious Amazon jungle. While still being compelled by bloodthirsty mutated creatures and dark forces, you have to find out what causes the mutation in Amazon water sources and unveil the truths about the dark forces attemptting to change the earth's ecosystem.

Features
. Real-world shooting experiences: Use various kinds of weapons to fight the enemies. Destroy all of them while placing yourself in the thick of the fight, immersing in the realistic and thrilling shooting experience.
. Intense fighting experiences: Venturing deeper and deeper into the underground lab, striking down the enemies and fighting your way through. You are at risk of being killed at anytime, any unguarded moment would cause a complete failure.
. Vivid game scenes: Once the game started, you are present in the very scene of the underground lab. Your mission is to defeat all of the variants. Fire them away, as in the real world.
Dramatic pacing: Hard-won freedom or raging bullets around the next corner, you will never know. Hold tightly to your gun, find the only way to get out of the perilous and mysterious jungle.

reviews.review:
This maybe took 1 guy a week or 2  to make.......It is literally a 3 minute game. I has no changable settings whatsoever. You are forced to go through the tutorial every time you play. OH and its literally 1 FCING ROOM!!!!! The whole game!!!!. This game is worth 42 cents......for 5 bucks I want at least 30 minutes of entertainment.......the only thing I can say positive about it is it works and your not stuck in one spot the entire time. I experienced no problems running it....Although even running a 1070 i experienced some fps dips.....but that aint saying much for a game thats over faster than i can take a dump......

The textures are washed out.....the animations are stiff and theres 3 enemies total in the game....flyer..... crawler.....walker.......I believe theres a total of 5 sound files in the game........

Every one of these games that has chinese writing in the titles has been a short cash grab.....never again will i waste my money

Garbage like this is whats ruining VR and making people who are on the fence of buying VR hardware think twice before investing their money......STOP MAKING THIS JUNK!!!!!!
reviews.developer_response:
Dear SGT, 

It's a pity that our game didn't provide you with pleasant experience, while also leaving you a bad impression on Chinese VR games.
Sureal is a startup team focusing on VR game design and production. We strive everyday for our dream, hoping that one day we could be able to make our own high-end games. We are desperate to see that someday Sureal could make this game that only"took 1 guy a week or 2". The Souce of Evil is our first VR game, there's still room for improvement, but we did make it with all our hearts. 
As a startup team, we did put a lot of effort, resource, time and money in this 'simple' game as in your eyes. Like most game teams, we hope to gain a little revenue via Steam to subsidize our expense, but we hope for more encouragement and support from players to motivate us to fulfill our dream.
Thanks for playing and leaving your feedback. You have offered some good advice to a team that is charting a path toward VR business. We will keep working on this game and release more interesting contents.

Thank you for your support. Thanks for all the player's support!
